title: Model Extrapolation Expedites Alignment

live_model.evidence: "a GPT-4 Turbo evaluator prefers the output of the evaluated model over the GPT-4 baseline"; "...bias of the GPT-4 Turbo evaluator (i.e., the prior...)" (AlpacaEval-style pairwise judge).

prompt.note: Judge is the standard AlpacaEval-style pairwise comparison prompt (external convention); not reproduced in the retrieved text.

claim.metric: none isolated for GPT-4 Turbo itself (it produces win-rate labels used to score OTHER fine-tuned models, e.g. ExPO-extrapolated checkpoints)

data.source: GPT-4-annotated preference data (line ~295) and standard alignment benchmarks; specific release not confirmed in retrieved text

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is used purely as an AlpacaEval-style pairwise judge scoring win rates of the paper's own extrapolated (ExPO) model checkpoints against baselines; it is never the subject whose own capability is reported, so there is no reproducible number describing GPT-4 Turbo itself.
